attributes.cardDescription: Record a shipment leg as delivered and advance the order status appropriately for that leg.
attributes.readMe:
## Mark Delivered

Leg-aware: a `seller-to-auth` delivery advances `Order.orderStatus` to `authenticating` (item arrived at the auth centre, not yet with the buyer); an `auth-to-buyer` delivery advances it to `delivered`.

### Example

`linkedExamples` points at the command's natural target: `Shipment/sv-2026-1041-inbound`.

### Honest gap, stated in the command's own header comment

`delivered → completed` (the buyer's own confirmation that releases funds to the seller) has no command — no command marks it. Left as an explicit, undone edge rather than silently folded into a carrier-scan event.
